# Reasons to be Cheerful

> A nonprofit media outlet showcasing solutions-focused journalism on sustainability, climate action, civic engagement, and social progress around the world.

Reasons to be Cheerful publishes in-depth stories and curated collections highlighting positive environmental and social initiatives, policy innovations, and community-led solutions. The site features both standalone articles and thematic series like Waterline, covering topics from renewable energy and sustainable agriculture to social support systems and urban design.

## Key Topics

- climate-action

## Collections & Series

- [Collections - Reasons to be Cheerful](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/collections): Curated story collections on sustainability, climate, and social issues
- [Waterline Archives - Reasons to be Cheerful](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/collection/waterline): Waterline series on sustainable water use in farming and food systems
- [Waterline: The Mississippi River Basin Archives](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/collection/mississippi-river): Mississippi River Basin stories on conservation, agriculture, and identity

## Climate & Environment Solutions

- [A Vermont City's Decision to Go 100% Green Is Paying Off](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/vermont-burlington-renewable-energy-credit): Burlington's 100% renewable energy transition improving municipal credit
- [The Native Seed Farm Safeguarding California's Future](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/heritage-growers-california-future): Native seed farm restoration work advancing California conservation goals
- [What We're Reading: Fireproofing Entire California Neighborhoods](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/what-were-reading-fire-resistant-neighborhoods): Weekly roundup on fire-resistant building and livable wage initiatives
- [Can Disposable Diapers Go Sustainable?](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/sustainable-compostable-diapers): Exploration of compostable diaper alternatives reducing household waste
- [The Spiritual Movement Saving a Gentle Giant](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/whale-sharks-spiritual-movement-saving-a-gentle-giant): Indian whale shark conservation through spiritual and fishermen activism

## Urban & Social Innovation

- [What We're Reading: Paris Is More Bike-Friendly Than Ever](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/what-were-reading-paris-bike-friendly): Weekly roundup featuring Paris cycling, housing policy, and sustainable cities
- [How the Netherlands Bent Bureaucracy Into Something Beautiful](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/breakthrough-method-netherlands): Netherlands Breakthrough Method for adaptive, citizen-centered governance
- [The German City That Defied McDonald's and Dumped 'To-Go' Waste](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/tubingen-germany-defied-mcdonalds-dumped-to-go-waste): Tübingen's successful single-use packaging ban and waste reduction policy
- [A Record Number of Americans Can Access Paid Leave](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/more-paid-leave-americans): Analysis of paid leave expansion affecting 46 million Americans via state laws

## Community & Support Systems

- [Stopping Domestic Abuse With a Trip to the Bank](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/safe-spaces-domestic-abuse-banks): UK Safe Spaces initiative providing abuse victims support via banks
- ['Solo Aging Doesn't Mean Aging Alone'](https://reasonstobecheerful.world/solo-aging-resources-planning): Resources and support networks emerging for seniors aging without family
